decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks have not been visible for two years and are not tied to the digital shift, so the option's value has declined and resources are better redeployed.
PETG thermoforming blanks support digital manufacturing workflows, so the option remains valuable and cheap to keep until demand clarifies through trade channels.
UV-curing lacquer had only a minor website presence and no observed results for two years, indicating its value is unlikely to be realized.
Intraoral contrast spray has niche adoption and no observed market presence since 2019, making further investment hard to justify.
Custom hearing protection earmolds have not shown traction and are peripheral to the digital strategy, so the option is closed to release resources.
